name: 径向频谱分析
description: Analyzes the radially-averaged frequency spectrum for characteristic patterns. AI-generated images often show anomalous spectral profiles.
mechanism: Computes radially-averaged power spectrum and analyzes spectral profile shape. Deviations from natural profiles indicate manipulation.
parameters: FFT: adaptive, Averaging: radial bins, Metric: profile deviation
useCase: Detecting spectral anomalies in AI-generated images

references.title: Dzanic, T. et al. (2020). Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images. NeurIPS.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch Your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Networks. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures radial frequency distribution patterns
• Effective for detecting GAN checkerboard artifacts
• Azimuthal averaging reduces noise
• Content-independent spectral analysis
• Fast computation using FFT
limitations:
• Less effective for diffusion model artifacts
• JPEG compression adds spectral noise
• Small images limit radial frequency resolution
• Isotropic assumption may miss directional artifacts
• Some generators produce clean radial spectra
